english.note: Use 手頭緊 when someone has little money available, not when they are stingy.
Use 手頭緊 specifically when someone is short of money or has little cash available.

examples.english: I'm tight on cash lately, so I'll pay you back later.
examples.traditional: 我最近手頭緊，遲啲先還錢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sau2 tau4 gan2 ci4 di1 sin1 waan4 cin2
